description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for the behavior of 'git mv' command in sparse checkout scenarios. It verifies various edge cases and interactions related to moving files and directories within a Git repository that has sparse-checkout enabled.

methods.name: setup_sparse_checkout
methods.description: Sets up a sparse-checkout environment by creating a directory, adding a file, and configuring sparse-checkout with specific patterns.

methods.name: cleanup_sparse_checkout
methods.description: Disables sparse-checkout and resets Git state.
